title: SwarmWorld: Stigmergic technological evolution in societies of language-model agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.26081v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Collective intelligence can emerge when individuals coordinate through a shared environment, allowing local actions to accumulate into durable social organization. Language-model agents offer a new substrate for this process, yet most multi-agent systems rely on direct conversation, predefined roles, or centralized workflows. It remains unclear whether decentralized agents can build functional technologies and outperform independent search. Here, initially homogeneous LLM agents in SwarmWorld self-organize without assigned roles or recipes into evolving technological societies. Agents explore a spatial environment, process resources, test materials, construct persistent artifacts, and write executable controllers evaluated by a deterministic simulator under unseen disturbances after the agents are removed. SwarmWorld splits cognition from consequence: agents propose architectures and controllers within fixed action and material schemas

translated_title: SwarmWorld：语言模型代理社会中的信息素技术演化
translated_abstract: 摘要：当个体通过共享环境进行协调时，集体智能可以涌现，使局部行动累积为持久的社会组织。语言模型代理为这一过程提供了新的基础，但大多数多代理系统依赖直接对话、预定义角色或集中式工作流程。目前尚不清楚去中心化代理能否构建功能性技术并超越独立搜索。在此，SwarmWorld中初始同质的LLM代理在无指定角色或配方的情况下自组织成不断演化的技术社会。代理探索空间环境、处理资源、测试材料、构建持久工件，并编写可执行控制器，这些控制器在代理被移除后由确定性模拟器在未知扰动下进行评估。SwarmWorld将认知与后果分离：代理在固定动作和材料模式内提出架构和控制器。
tldr: 该论文提出SwarmWorld框架，展示去中心化语言模型代理通过共享环境自组织演化出功能性技术，并超越独立搜索性能。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces SwarmWorld, demonstrating that decentralized language-model agents self-organize through a shared environment to evolve functional technologies, outperforming independent search.
